title: Kummer Stratum Geometry
statement: Lift the given finite SNC component family and a chosen finite subset only to the site universe, preserving the actual components and subset. Define H=(product over q≠p,ell of Z_q)^I and its inclusion in the existing full parameter-root deck group by inserting zero in ell coordinates. Finite prime-to-ell image means the representation image of this subgroup is finite and its order is coprime to ell, including rank zero and empty I. Built from [def-sfb-tame-root-chart-geometry], [def-sfb-finite-continuous-kummer-coefficient-model], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull].
